issue: No validation feedback shown to user
actual: Submitting the reservation form with no date, time, guest name, email, or phone silently fails: no reservation is created (confirmed via My Reservations showing 0 upcoming), but no error message, toast, aria-invalid attribute, or error styling appears anywhere on the page or in the notification region. issue: Date cannot be modified for an existing reservation
actual: The "Modify Reservation" dialog for an upcoming reservation only offers "New Time" and "Party Size" selects; there is no date field/control. evidence: Creating a reservation showed an immediate toast "Reservation Confirmed!" plus confirmation panel, and it appeared in Upcoming reservations without reload. Modifying time/party size showed updated values (20:00, 4 Guests) reflected immediately in the reservations list in the same session without a manual reload.

Clicked Cancel on upcoming reservation, confirmed via "Cancel Reservation" in confirmation dialog. Reservation removed from Upcoming (now 0) and appeared in Past (1) with status "Cancelled", retaining date/time/party size details.

Modify dialog opened via "Modify" button, changes to time/party size saved via "Save Changes" and reflected immediately. Cancel button opened an alertdialog "Cancel Reservation?" requiring explicit "Cancel Reservation" click (with a "Keep Reservation" escape option that correctly left the reservation intact when tested); only after confirming did the reservation get cancelled.

Toast "Review Submitted!" appeared, review count went from (1) to (2), rating updated 4.0→4.5, and new review appears in Reviews (2) list with all submitted fields.

issue: Review submission is not restricted to restaurants with a completed reservation
actual: Submitted a review for Trattoria Bella despite having no reservation (completed or otherwise) at that restaurant at all. The review was accepted without any eligibility check, confirmed with "Review Submitted!" toast and the review appearing in the restaurant's review list. This shows the app does not enforce that a review requires a completed reservation for that restaurant, nor limits reviews to one per completed reservation.

evidence: Before review: Trattoria Bella showed rating 4.0 (1 review) on detail page. After submitting a 5-star review, detail page updated to 4.5 (2 reviews), and the restaurant list card (after full navigation/reload) also shows 4.5, confirming consistency between list and detail summaries derived from reviews.

Applying GROUP15 with party size 2 was rejected with "Coupon Not Applicable - This coupon requires a party of 6 or more."
